coverage.analytical_scope: All eligible admitted records; no silent sampling. Retained curve points and witnesses are bounded.
limitations: Supplied outcomes are reference evidence, not independently verified truth.
Observed labels need not represent unobserved cases.
No universal score or production approval.
Unknown provenance does not establish out-of-sample evaluation.

execution.resource_qualification: Sampled RSS and storage controls can overshoot; admission settings are not capacity guarantees.
